I read the entire manga in the past few days, it is the craziest over the top rom com I have ever seen. This author deserves a cookie for his efforts into producing this hidden gem of a manga.

What I like about it the most is that the author is able to chug the story along at a good pace. with good character development all around for most of the characters. Almost every chapter literally has a character or two being fleshed out more, their personalities, etc. Plus the comedy. My God, every chapter had me in stitches with the situations the characters all get into.
